text_en: Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers and sisters, for you know that we who teach will be judged with greater strictness.
text_cn: 我的弟兄们！你们作教师的人，不要太多，该知道我们作教师的，要受更严厉的审判。

text_en: For all of us make many mistakes. Anyone who makes no mistakes in speaking is perfect, able to keep the whole body in check with a bridle.
text_cn: 实在，我们众人都犯许多过失； 谁若在言语上不犯过失，他便是个完人，也必能控制全身。

text_en: If we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we guide their whole bodies.
text_cn: 试看，我们把嚼环放在马嘴里，就可叫它们顺服我们，调动它们的全身。

text_en: Or look at ships: though they are so large that it takes strong winds to drive them, yet they are guided by a very small rudder wherever the will of the pilot directs.
text_cn: 又看，船只虽然很大，又为大风所吹动，只用小小的舵，便会随掌舵者的意思往前转动；

text_en: So also the tongue is a small member, yet it boasts of great exploits. How great a forest is set ablaze by a small fire!
text_cn: 同样，舌头虽然是一个小小的肢体，却能夸大。看，小小的火，能燃着广大的树林！

text_en: And the tongue is a fire. The tongue is placed among our members as a world of iniquity; it stains the whole body, sets on fire the cycle of nature, and is itself set on fire by hell.
text_cn: 舌头也像是火。舌头，这不义的世界，安置在我们的肢体中，玷污全身，由地狱取出火来，燃烧生命的轮子。

text_en: For every species of beast and bird, of reptile and sea creature, can be tamed and has been tamed by the human species,
text_cn: 各类的走兽、飞禽、爬虫、水族，都可以驯服，且已被人类驯服了；

text_en: but no one can tame the tongue—a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
text_cn: 至于舌头，却没有人能够驯服，且是个不止息的恶物，满含致死的毒汁。

text_en: With it we bless the Lord and Father, and with it we curse those who are made in the likeness of God.
text_cn: 我们用它赞颂上主和父，也用它诅咒那照天主的肖像而受造的人；

text_en: From the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers and sisters, this ought not to be so.
text_cn: 赞颂与诅咒竟从同一口里发出！我的弟兄们，这事决不该这样！

text_en: Does a spring pour forth from the same opening both fresh and brackish water?
text_cn: 泉源岂能从同一孔穴，涌出甜水和苦水来？

text_en: Can a fig tree, my brothers and sisters, yield olives, or a grapevine figs? No more can salt water yield fresh.
text_cn: 我的弟兄们，无花果树岂能结橄榄，或者葡萄树岂能结无花果？咸水也不能产生甜水。

text_en: Who is wise and understanding among you? Show by your good life that your works are done with gentleness born of wisdom.
text_cn: 你们中谁是有智慧，有见识的呢？让他用好品行，彰显他的行为是出于智慧的温和！

text_en: But if you have bitter envy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not be boastful and false to the truth.
text_cn: 若你们心里怀有恶毒的嫉妒和纷争，就不可夸耀，不可说谎违反真理。

text_en: Such wisdom does not come down from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, devilish.
text_cn: 这种智慧不是从上而来的，而是属于下地的，属于血肉的，属于魔鬼的；

text_en: For where there is envy and selfish ambition, there will also be disorder and wickedness of every kind.
text_cn: 因为哪里有嫉妒和纷争，哪里就有扰乱和种种恶行。

text_en: But the wisdom from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruits, without a trace of partiality or hypocrisy.
text_cn: 至于从上而来的智慧，它首先是纯洁的，其次是和平的，宽仁的，柔顺的，满有仁慈和善果的，不偏不倚的，没有伪善的。

text_en: And a harvest of righteousness is sown in peace for those who make peace.
text_cn: 为缔造和平的人，正义的果实，乃是在和平中种植的。
